answer: A newcomer floats a timber raft carrying three live jobs down a public river; each job is ferrous-stamped to the raft and re-run by a sparrow courier who flies the proof to a different downstream client staking 2 POA it was real. The nth identity from one wallet floats n rafts at once, posting 9n POA per raft (1st 9, 10th 900, 3,465 across ten); one failed re-run sinks the raft, slashes its bond, and nails the timber to a public board, so clones cannot share one raft's honest cargo.
